name: Sea Salt Caramel Chip Chocolate Cookies

items: 1/2 cup butter or margarine (1 stick), softened
1-2/3 cups Hershey's sea salt caramel flavored baking chips (10-oz pkg)
Heat oven to 350°F. Line cookie sheet with parchment paper or lightly grease.
Beat butter, brown sugar, granulated sugar and vanilla in large bowl until well blended. Add eggs; beat well.
Stir together flour, cocoa, baking soda and salt; gradually blend into butter mixture, blending well.
Drop by rounded teaspoons onto prepared cookie sheet.
Bake 7 to 9 minutes or until cookie is set. Do not over bake.
Cool slightly; remove from cookie sheet to wire rack. Cool completely.
